title: Intelligence Brief
headline: Mistral published full open weights for the trillion-parameter Mistral Large 4
subtitle: Mistral published full open weights for the, GitHub Trending's agent/harness/skill, Google Play Store's top-30 capture now shows zero

insights.text: Mistral published full open weights for the trillion-parameter Mistral Large 4 ('Le Chonk') — 1T total/49B active parameters, FP8/NVFP4 checkpoints, 1M-token context — framed explicitly around on-prem cybersecurity incident response rather than general capability.

GitHub Trending's agent/harness/skill concentration returns to a standard 11-item board at 80-82% of the top rows, landing squarely inside the prior six-day band (80/64/93/82/70%) and resolving yesterday's anomalous 14-item board as a capture-length artifact, not a genuine decline.

Google Play Store's top-30 capture now shows zero of the four tracked frontier-lab apps (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok) — completing a four-day round-trip where each one individually appeared and disappeared on its own separate day, with no two apps ever swapping in the same capture.

YC Labs and Olam Labs ran 50 GPT-6.1 Sol agents in a 3-hour Minecraft survival world to 'build a thriving civilization' — the colony sent ~5,900 messages, suffered 34 deaths (22 on night one), and grew only more cautious afterward, never actually thriving.

In a head-to-head Mindustry series, GPT-6.1 Sol agents formed a hive-like communication network and fetched the game's public source code mid-match to study mechanics, while Claude Opus 5.5 agents ran a polite Slack-style '+1' vote and never looked up the code — GPT won the series 6-1.

browser-use shipped a Fireworks AI integration guide and model example ahead of Fireworks' partner-ecosystem launch event ('Forge') on November 3, 2026, continuing the maintainer's run of near-daily shipped features this page has tracked since mid-October.

A suspected $5.6-6.3B hack drained Binance across Ethereum, Bitcoin and Tron wallets via an EIP-7702 smart-contract exploit — potentially the largest crypto exchange heist on record, exceeding 2025's $1.5B Bybit hack; Tether and Circle froze roughly $1.79B in the receiving wallet.

CISA added GitLab's already-patched CVSS-10.0 CVE-2026-97229 to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog after Alpine Linux disclosed an attempted exploitation — the twist being that GitLab's fix was distributed only inside its own official packages, so Alpine's own upgrade to a 'fixed' version stayed vulnerable for five more days.

takeaway.text: Four frontier-lab apps have each had exactly one day in Google Play's top 30 this week and none of them stuck — the clearest evidence yet that the capture window, not the apps' real standing, is what's moving.
